name: notifications
description: The notifications service of the zigordev platform, made from the API half of the product template

scripts.lint: biome ci . && markdownlint-cli2 && zizmor --offline . && zigordev check
scripts.check:quick: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && vitest run --project '!*:db'
scripts.check: start=$(date +%s); pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test; code=$?; echo "check took $(( $(date +%s) - start )) s"; exit $code
scripts.local:up: zigordev-stack up && docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml up --build --detach --wait
scripts.local:reset: docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml down --volumes && pnpm run local:up
scripts.dev: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "Name the app: pnpm dev api" >&2; exit 2; }; exec pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter "./apps/*-$1" run dev' --
scripts.check:contract: docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml build && POSTGRES_PASSWORD=contract-only NOTIFICATIONS_API_DATABASE_PASSWORD=contract-only zigordev contract
